headline: Jensen Huang resigns as Nvidia CEO; CFO Colette Kress named interim chief
headline_es: Jensen Huang renuncia como CEO de Nvidia; la directora financiera Colette Kress asume de forma interina
caption_en: Nvidia co-founder Jensen Huang resigned on Thursday as chief executive, effective immediately, ending his decades-long run at the head of the chipmaker. Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress will serve as interim CEO while keeping her finance role until the board names a permanent successor.
caption_es: El cofundador de Nvidia, Jensen Huang, renunció el jueves como director ejecutivo con efecto inmediato, poniendo fin a décadas al frente del fabricante de chips. La directora financiera Colette Kress será CEO interina, sin dejar su cargo financiero, hasta que la junta nombre a un sucesor permanente.
summary_es: La salida se anunció un día después de que la junta se reuniera para decidir su futuro.
summary_en: The exit was announced a day after the board met to decide his future.
